tools.name: measure_connection
tools.description: Measures the download and upload speed of the internet connection of this computer, against Dten's measurement servers. Free, no account. Takes about 1 minute, up to 10 on a very slow network, and uses data in proportion to the speed: about 375 MB per direction at 100 Mbps and 3.7 GB at 1 Gbps. The record goes to Dten's archive, with no account and no name, unless DTEN_SPEED_NO_SEND=1; `dten-speed forget` deletes it. Use it only when the person asks for a measurement, and warn that it can use up a mobile data allowance.

direction.description: Which direction to measure. Default: both, download first.
